mapper.select: SELECT id FROM trainers WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE'
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM trainer_assignments WHERE trainer_id=#{trainerId} AND member_id=#{memberId} AND status='ACTIVE')
SELECT name, phone, specialty FROM trainers WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE trainers SET name=#{form.name}, phone=#{form.phone}, specialty=#{form.specialty}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT m.id member_id,m.name,m.phone,COALESCE((SELECT mp.name FROM member_memberships mm JOIN membership_products mp ON mp.id=mm.product_id WHERE mm.member_id=m.id AND mm.status='ACTIVE' AND mm.end_date>=CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY mm.end_date LIMIT 1),'활성 회원권 없음') active_membership, (SELECT MAX(a.checked_in_at) FROM attendances a WHERE a.member_id=m.id) last_attendance_at,(SELECT MAX(ws.started_at) FROM workout_sessions ws WHERE ws.member_id=m.id) last_workout_at FROM trainers t JOIN trainer_assignments ta ON ta.trainer_id=t.id AND ta.status='ACTIVE' JOIN members m ON m.id=ta.member_id AND m.status='ACTIVE' WHERE t.user_id=#{userId} AND (m.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR m.phone LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY m.name
SELECT attendance_date,checked_in_at,checked_out_at FROM attendances WHERE member_id=#{memberId} ORDER BY checked_in_at DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT ws.id session_id,m.id member_id,m.name member_name,COALESCE(wr.title,'개인 운동') routine_title,ws.started_at,ws.ended_at,MAX(wset.exercise_name) exercise_name,COUNT(wset.id) sets,ws.memo FROM workout_sessions ws JOIN members m ON m.id=ws.member_id LEFT JOIN workout_routines wr ON wr.id=ws.routine_id LEFT JOIN workout_sets wset ON wset.session_id=ws.id JOIN trainer_assignments ta ON ta.member_id=m.id AND ta.status='ACTIVE' JOIN trainers t ON t.id=ta.trainer_id AND t.user_id=#{userId} WHERE (#{memberId} IS NULL OR m.id=#{memberId}) GROUP BY ws.id,m.id,m.name,wr.title,ws.started_at,ws.ended_at,ws.memo ORDER BY ws.started_at DESC

SELECT wr.id routine_id,m.id member_id,m.name member_name,wr.title,wr.description,wr.start_date,wr.end_date,re.exercise_name,re.target_sets,re.target_reps_min,re.target_reps_max,re.target_weight,re.rest_seconds,re.day_of_week FROM workout_routines wr JOIN trainers t ON t.id=wr.trainer_id AND t.user_id=#{userId} JOIN members m ON m.id=wr.member_id LEFT JOIN routine_exercises re ON re.routine_id=wr.id WHERE (#{memberId} IS NULL OR m.id=#{memberId}) ORDER BY wr.updated_at DESC,re.display_order

SELECT wr.id routine_id,m.id member_id,m.name member_name,wr.title,wr.description,wr.start_date,wr.end_date,re.exercise_name,re.target_sets,re.target_reps_min,re.target_reps_max,re.target_weight,re.rest_seconds,re.day_of_week FROM workout_routines wr JOIN trainers t ON t.id=wr.trainer_id AND t.user_id=#{userId} JOIN members m ON m.id=wr.member_id LEFT JOIN routine_exercises re ON re.routine_id=wr.id WHERE wr.id=#{routineId} ORDER BY re.display_order LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE workout_routines SET title=#{title},description=#{description},start_date=#{startDate},end_date=#{endDate},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{routineId} AND trainer_id=#{trainerId}
mapper.select: SELECT ws.id session_id,m.id member_id,m.name member_name,COALESCE(wr.title,'개인 운동') routine_title,ws.started_at,ws.ended_at,MAX(wset.exercise_name) exercise_name,COUNT(wset.id) sets,ws.memo FROM workout_sessions ws JOIN members m ON m.id=ws.member_id LEFT JOIN workout_routines wr ON wr.id=ws.routine_id LEFT JOIN workout_sets wset ON wset.session_id=ws.id JOIN trainer_assignments ta ON ta.member_id=m.id AND ta.status='ACTIVE' JOIN trainers t ON t.id=ta.trainer_id AND t.user_id=#{userId} WHERE ws.id=#{sessionId} GROUP BY ws.id,m.id,m.name,wr.title,ws.started_at,ws.ended_at,ws.memo
mapper.update: UPDATE workout_sessions SET routine_id=#{routineId},started_at=#{startedAt},ended_at=#{endedAt},memo=#{memo},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{sessionId} AND member_id=#{memberId}
